title: Court booking API in Express
idea: The court booking API exposes availability, create and cancel as REST endpoints, with each layer doing one job and PostgreSQL deciding who gets an hour.

analogy.text: A club front desk. The clerk checks the form, the manager applies the rules, the records room files it.
analogy.breaks: The records room here refuses clashes on its own.

points: Controllers parse input with zod and demand an Idempotency-Key on create.
The service prices the hours and runs everything in one transaction.
The repository holds SQL only; the unique index reports a taken hour.
One error middleware maps validation, domain and database errors to status codes.

code.title: Layered Express app
code.caption: Repository, service, controllers and error mapping in one file on a real PostgreSQL. Payment, refunds and expiring stale holds (page 6) are left out to keep it short. A rolled-back insert still uses up its SERIAL number, so the last id is BK-4. Real code scopes the Idempotency-Key to the signed-in player, so one user cannot replay another's booking.

walk.text: A trimmed page 6 schema: bookings, one row per hour, and the partial unique index.
`tx` gives each service call one transaction and rolls back on any error.
Insert the PENDING booking with a deadline, then one slot row per hour.
This demo cancels only PENDING holds; cancelling CONFIRMED adds the refund step left out.
Replay a known key; else price each hour (UTC here, the ground's zone in real code), insert, claim.
Controllers validate with `zod`. Express 5 passes async throws to the error middleware.
Map errors by type and by constraint name: a taken hour becomes 409 SLOT_TAKEN.

pitfalls: Check the Idempotency-Key before anything else, or a retry gets a 409 instead of a replay.
Map errors by constraint name, not only by code 23505; two unique rules share it.
Never keep a transaction open while calling the payment provider.

quiz.q: What status does the last request in api.mjs get?
options: 200, a replay of the earlier k-2 call
quiz.why: The first k-2 call rolled back, so no row stores that key. Cancel set BK-1's slots inactive, so the partial index allows 17:00 again.

takeaway: Validate at the edge, decide in the service, let constraints settle races.
